BiblicalUsage: Pi-ha-Chiroth was the place by the sea where Israel camped before the crossing. God told them to turn and encamp before Pi-hahiroth in Exodus 14:2, and Pharaoh's army overtook them there in Exodus 14:9. They departed from before Pi-hahiroth and passed through the midst of the sea, says Numbers 33:8.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Pi-ha-Chiroth is the place of no way out — sea in front, army behind — and the exact place God parts the water.
RelatedEvents: The Exodus and the Red Sea
